svg.title: Subtraction
svg.text: Stage 6, Subtract: take the loud ones out, listen again
B · The same slot before and after the 21 pass-1 decodes are removed (average spectrum)
after: the residual that pass 2 searches
C · Decodes per pass in this slot
Pass 3 found nothing new here, so the slot finished.
D · Over all 22 test recordings (WSJT-X decoded 353 messages)
Subtraction is worth 48 extra messages (+18 %), for about three times
the decoding time: 0.6 s → 1.8 s per slot on average.
Example: CQ E74BYZ (922 Hz) was hidden under CQ UY5AX (915 Hz), the signal from stage 3's tone grid. It appeared as soon as UY5AX was removed.
